prompt: Dramatic power-up pose change. Immediately LOWER BOTH ARMS: move both orange boxing gloves all the way DOWN from his face to beside his WAIST. His face and chest become unobstructed. Spread elbows out, both forearms point downward, both fists clenched beside the hips. Bend both knees into a deep wide squat, lean torso forward and bow head, then arch chest up with chin raised while holding BOTH GLOVES LOW AT THE HIPS, straining and trembling with effort. Remain in this low-glove power-up stance for most frames. This is not boxing guard and not idle breathing. No punches. No flames or effects. No transformation. Same character and outfit, fixed camera.
